answer_3.quote: After obtaining the final annotated results, we pair annotated queries with code and used the GPT-4turbo model to score (0-3) and evaluate the quality of generated queries.

answer_4.quote: We extracte 200 pairs of queries and code snippets from the Query4Code dataset and invited three experts to score them according to the four types mentioned in Section 4.6.
answer_4.guideline: Experts scored pairs based on four scenarios: 1) code can answer and exceed the query requirements; 2) code can satisfy certain categories of query requirements; 3) code satisfies less than 50% of query requirements; 4) code has almost no relevance to the query.
